# Spark Doc Electric

> Licensed residential electrician based in Olathe, KS. Panel upgrades, panel replacement, troubleshooting, EV chargers, and emergency electrical. Call (913) 390-3780 or book online.

## Olathe hub

- [Electrician in Olathe, KS](https://sparkdockc.com/areas/olathe-ks.html): Home base for Spark Doc Electric. Licensed work across Olathe.

## Money services

- [Panel Upgrade](https://sparkdockc.com/services/panel-upgrade.html): 100A, 200A, and 400A breaker panel upgrades with permits.
- [Panel Replacement](https://sparkdockc.com/services/panel-replacement.html): Replace failed, obsolete, or insurance-flagged breaker boxes.
- [Electrical Troubleshooting](https://sparkdockc.com/services/electrical-troubleshooting.html): Diagnose and fix flickering lights, dead rooms, and breaker issues.
- [EV Charger Installation](https://sparkdockc.com/services/ev-charger-installation.html): Level 2 home EV charger installs with circuits and permits.
- [Emergency Electrician](https://sparkdockc.com/services/emergency-electrician.html): Around-the-clock response for sparking panels and power loss.
- [GFCI Outlet Repair](https://sparkdockc.com/services/gfci-outlet-repair.html): Repair and install GFCI protection in kitchens, baths, and outdoors.
- [Surge Protection](https://sparkdockc.com/services/surge-protection.html): Whole-home surge protectors installed at the panel.
- [Dedicated Circuits](https://sparkdockc.com/services/dedicated-circuits.html): New circuits for EV chargers, ranges, shops, and high-demand loads.
